name: Randomizer
author: nerderror
description: Shuffles fixed item rewards (mission loot, bounties, world map artifacts, quest rewards) and replaces enemies with enemies from the whole game; optionally weapon damage and prices. Two presets: Balanced and Chaos. Same seed = same game. Story items never move. Writes a spoiler log to SWH2ModLoader/Reports/Randomizer.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Leave empty for a random seed (it is saved after installing).

settings.label: Preset
settings.help: Sets all options below. Changing any of them by hand switches to Custom.

choices.label: Balanced — plays like the normal game

settings.label: Shuffle fixed item rewards
settings.help: Mission loot, region bounties, world map artifacts/flagships, quest rewards. Story items never move. Shops are not changed.

settings.label: Randomize enemies
settings.help: Enemies in spawn tables (initial spawns and reinforcements) are replaced by enemies from the whole game, without repeats inside a table. Bosses and scripted enemies stay.

choices.label: Balanced (health & damage of the enemy it replaces)
Of the enemy it replaces (no infighting)

settings.label: Chaos limits
settings.help: Chaos stats only. Caps how much stronger an enemy can be than the one it replaces, and stronger enemies come in smaller numbers.

choices.label: Fair (health up to 2x, damage up to 1.5x)
Loose (health up to 3x, damage up to 2x)
